snippet.title: Skinwalker | Latin American Games Showcase TGA 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
Skinwalker is a hack n’ slash action platformer where you swear allegiance to a formidable beast to save your daughter from a terminal illness. Shapeshift into the creature’s monstrous form and wield untamed wrath in exchange for its freedom and the promise of a cure.
